claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO frames object detection as a single regression problem from image pixels to bounding box coordinates and class probabilities.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We reframe object detection as a single regression problem, straight from image pixels to bounding box coordinates and class probabilities.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The base YOLO model processes images at 45 frames per second in real-time.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our base YOLO model processes images in real-time at 45 frames per second.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast YOLO achieves 155 frames per second while attaining double the mAP of other real-time detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: A smaller version of the network, Fast YOLO, processes an astounding 155 frames per second while still achieving double the mAP of other real-time detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO makes less than half the number of background errors compared to Fast R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO makes less than half the number of background errors compared to Fast R-CNN.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO outperforms DPM and R-CNN when generalizing from natural images to artwork.
claims.evidence_quote_short: It outperforms other detection methods, including DPM and R-CNN, when generalizing from natural images to other domains like artwork.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO struggles to precisely localize some objects, especially small ones.
claims.evidence_quote_short: While it can quickly identify objects in images it struggles to precisely localize some objects, especially small ones.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Combining YOLO with Fast R-CNN increases mAP by 3.2% to 75.0% on VOC 2007.
claims.evidence_quote_short: When combined with YOLO, its mAP increases by 3.2% to 75.0%.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO imposes strong spatial constraints that limit the number of nearby objects it can predict.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This spatial constraint limits the number of nearby objects that our model can predict.
